tested_scope: One bounded official-GitHub documentation search for historical immutable-release tag-reservation observability and stable rejection semantics through lightweight Git/ref/release/repository APIs, including repository deletion/recreation, rename/transfer continuity, and GitHub Free/no-finite-monthly-quota availability. No live destructive repository experiment was performed.

official_sources.observation: GitHub documents that after deleting an immutable release, the tag may be deleted but the same tag name cannot be reused; it also documents repository-resurrection protection when a repository is deleted and recreated with the same name.

GitHub documents repository/organization enablement and states immutability applies only to future releases. The retrieved bounded source did not specify historical reservation query semantics or plan/quota guarantees.

The repository REST docs expose a check for whether immutable releases are enabled and enable/disable endpoints. The retrieved bounded source describes setting state, not a historical deleted-release tag-reservation record or reservation-status lookup.

The release-create endpoint documents generic 201/404/422 outcomes in the retrieved source; no reservation-specific stable rejection status/body for a tag name reserved by a deleted immutable release was surfaced.

GitHub documents GitHub Free and says public repositories have a full feature set, but the retrieved bounded source did not explicitly enumerate immutable releases or prove the feature's historical-reservation semantics under a no-finite-monthly/trial/paid-quota condition.

inference_and_scope_guard: The positive anti-reuse statements are strong repository-resurrection evidence only for the cases GitHub explicitly documents. Absence of a reservation-specific API/status contract, rename/transfer continuity text, or explicit plan/quota statement in this bounded retrieval is not evidence that those properties are false; it means Part112 cannot use them as Phase-1 acceptance proof. Generic 422 documentation must not be treated as a stable reservation-specific fencing code without a source that binds it to this condition.

phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Part112 did not retrieve a lightweight historical-reservation observability endpoint, a reservation-specific stable create-ref/tag rejection contract, rename/transfer/owner-name-reuse continuity semantics, or explicit GitHub Free/no-finite-monthly-quota availability.
